title: Minecraft: Nightfall Shelter
story_hook: The sun is setting, Explorer! You need to build a shelter before nightfall. This is a Minecraft mission!

tasks.instruction: Explorer, gather 10 sticks from the trees. Use your hands to collect them. This is a resource!
Explorer, use the sticks to build a small wall. Make it at least 3 blocks high. This is a block!
Explorer, find 5 leaves from the trees. These are resources. Collect them carefully.
Explorer, use the crayon to draw a line around your block wall. This helps you observe it. It’s like marking a block in Minecraft!
Explorer, race to collect 3 stones. The fastest one wins! This is a resource.

finale: You built a shelter, Explorer! Good job!
